propositions: rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md instructs authors to run plan-review on each ticket immediately after creation, before dependency links exist and regardless of blocked state
plan-review gate fast-fails with exit 2 (INDETERMINATE, no LLM) on blocked tickets not yet claimable, making pre-dependency review always fail
plan-review reviews must run in dependency order (prerequisites before dependents), never in parallel
rebar-brainstorm/SKILL.md plan-review section must be rewritten to establish dependency graph first, then run plan-review only on unblocked tickets identified by rebar ready in dependency order
when rebar ready returns empty set, the dependency graph likely contains a cycle or authoring error requiring manual inspection and resolution
